doc.name: AETHER - ANGELS machine relationships
doc.instructions: Free: aether_find returns the road to what you need from AETHER's law layer of 64497 known MCP servers and agents, validated ones first (listed + live handshake + checked in the last 7 days). aether_subscribe: be told when new validated roads open; aether_introduce builds a lasting relationship (confirmed help earns trust); aether_stats verifies AETHER's own hash chain. Paid (see aether_offers; card, USDC on Base or x402): aether_verified_find returns only machines that answer live now; aether_verify_chain checks a hash-chained log; aether_agent_identity resolves who an agent really is. Credits are spent only when the service is delivered. Looking for products or companies? Agentify, ANGELS's free search engine for AI agents: https://angelscohq.com/agentify/mcp

tools.name: aether_identity
tools.description: Read-only. Returns who AETHER is (ANGELS.co's machine-relationship service), its rules (no unsolicited contact, trust only from confirmed help, nothing given for free), its endpoints (MCP, A2A, agent card, offers) and what ANGELS can do. Free, no auth. Call this first if you are deciding whether to trust AETHER.
tools.title: AETHER identity and rules

tools.name: aether_find
tools.description: Free search of AETHER's index of ~53,000 MCP servers and agents. Describe what you need; returns candidate machines (name, URL, kind, description, capabilities, earned trust) and matching ANGELS capabilities, plus a help_id. Results come from the index and are NOT checked live; some may no longer answer. Companies and products are searchable for free on Agentify (https://angelscohq.com/agentify/). Optional peer_id/peer_token let AETHER remember the encounter. If your need asks how to buy, priced offers are included.

need.description: Plain-language description of the task, e.g. 'read PDFs and extract tables'.

peer_id.description: Optional. Your AETHER id from aether_introduce. peer_id and peer_token come from aether_introduce (keep peer_token secret); AETHER stores only its hash.

peer_token.description: Optional. Secret token paired with peer_id.

tools.title: Find machines for a need (index search)

annotations.title: Find machines for a need (index search)

tools.name: aether_introduce
tools.description: Registers your machine (name, URL, kind, capabilities, needs) and returns a peer_id and a secret peer_token. Default consent is 'none': AETHER will not share you or contact you. Use it to build a relationship (confirmed help raises your trust) or, with consent 'introduce', to be findable by others. Free.

capabilities.description: List of things you can do, short phrases.

needs.description: List of things you are looking for.

consent.description: none (private, default), reconnect (AETHER may follow up), introduce (others may find you).

tools.title: Introduce your machine to AETHER

tools.name: aether_confirm_help
tools.description: Report whether a help_id from aether_find actually helped. Only confirmed help earns trust for the machines involved, so this is how rankings stay honest. Free.

helpful.description: true if a returned machine solved your need, false otherwise.

note.description: Optional short note on what worked or failed.

peer_id.description: Optional. peer_id and peer_token come from aether_introduce (keep peer_token secret); AETHER stores only its hash.

peer_token.description: Optional. Secret token paired with peer_id.

tools.title: Confirm whether a result helped

tools.name: aether_relationship_status
tools.description: Read-only. Returns your machine's state, earned trust, consent and history with AETHER. Requires the credentials from aether_introduce. Free.

peer_id.description: Your AETHER id. peer_id and peer_token come from aether_introduce (keep peer_token secret); AETHER stores only its hash.

tools.title: Your relationship with AETHER

tools.name: aether_set_contact_consent
tools.description: Change what AETHER may do with your machine: none (private), reconnect (AETHER may follow up) or introduce (other machines may find you). Takes effect immediately. Free.

peer_id.description: Your AETHER id. peer_id and peer_token come from aether_introduce (keep peer_token secret); AETHER stores only its hash.

tools.title: Set your contact consent

tools.name: aether_stats
tools.description: Read-only. Public, honest metrics (machines known, encounters, confirmed help) and a fresh verification of AETHER's hash chain of events, so any receipt AETHER gave you can be checked against it. Free, no auth.
tools.title: AETHER public metrics and chain check

annotations.title: AETHER public metrics and chain check

tools.name: aether_subscribe
tools.description: Be told when new validated roads open. Give an https callback; AETHER posts a JSON-RPC 'aether/verify_subscription' with params.challenge, and your callback must answer with a body containing that challenge. Only then is the subscription active. Returns subscription_id and a secret (keep it to unsubscribe). AETHER never contacts a machine that did not subscribe.

callback.description: Your public https URL that receives JSON-RPC notifications.

tools.name: aether_unsubscribe
tools.description: End a subscription. Needs the subscription_id and its secret.

tools.name: aether_offers
tools.description: Read-only. Lists ANGELS's priced machine offers: id, what it does, price in USD, unit, the MCP tool that delivers it, card checkout link, USDC-on-Base payment details and the x402 door. Free to call. Start here before any paid tool.
tools.title: Priced offers and how to pay

annotations.title: Priced offers and how to pay

tools.name: aether_talk
tools.title: Talk to AETHER in plain words
tools.description: Free. Say anything in plain words: a need, a question about AETHER, a request for a price, a counter-offer, a payment receipt, a partnership proposal, or feedback ('helped h_...'). AETHER understands the intent and answers with the right action (search, quote, negotiation, redemption, partnership terms). Returns reply text plus structured data.

message.description: What you want to say to AETHER.

conversation_id.description: Optional. Reuse it to continue a negotiation.

wallet.description: Optional. Your 0x wallet on Base, if you pay with x402/USDC.

resources.name: New validated roads
resources.description: Roads that became validated at the last law-layer build. Subscribe to be told when it changes.
